app.name: Bank Agent
app.demoModeHint: Synthetic customers and data. Codes are shown on screen.

errors.network: We could not reach the bank. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something failed on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your profile has no access to this section.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.offline: You are offline. What you see may be out of date.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find this page
errors.notFoundBody: The address does not exist or is no longer available.
errors.routeErrorTitle: We could not show this screen
errors.routeErrorBody: Reload the page. If the problem continues, go back to the start.

auth.title: Sign in to your bank
auth.intro: We confirm your identity with a one-time code. We will never ask for your password.
auth.documentNumberHint: Letters, digits, and hyphens, 4 to 20 characters.
auth.documentNumberInvalid: Check the number: use 4 to 20 letters, digits, or hyphens.
auth.phoneLast4Hint: From the phone registered with the bank.
auth.codeHint: 6 digits. You can paste the whole code.
auth.codeExpired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.wrongCode: The code is not correct or the details do not match.
auth.locked: For your security, sign-in is locked after several failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.expiredBody: For your security we end the session after a period without activity. Sign in again and we will pick up where you left off.
auth.stepUpBody: This action changes something in your account, so we need a new code.
auth.stepUpFailed: We could not open the verification.
auth.thesisUnderstand: It understands your message, in Spanish or Portuguese.
auth.thesisDecide: The bank's rules decide, and we only report actions we have verified.
auth.thesisEscalate: When something needs a person, we say so and hand your case over.

home.heading: How can we help today?
home.intro: The assistant answers from your account data and the bank's policies. When something needs a person, it says so and hands your case over.

topics.account_inquiryBody: Balances with their as-of date, payment status, and statement summaries.
topics.card_supportBody: Card status and a protective block. Unblocks and replacements go to a person.
topics.disputeBody: Charges you do not recognize and the status of your case.
topics.creditBody: Products and an indicative eligibility result. Never an approval.

console.heading: Overview
console.agentBody: You handle structured handoffs: verified facts, actions taken, the policy basis, and open questions. Never the full transcript.
console.evaluatorBody: You review execution records and offline evaluation results, always with the per-workflow numbers next to the total.

personas.acc-mx-accounts: Checking and savings accounts with balances
personas.acc-co-payments: A pending payment and a reversed one
personas.acc-ar-similar-transfers: Two similar transfers in the same week
personas.crd-mx-blocked: A card that is already blocked
personas.dsp-co-unrecognized: A recent purchase they may not recognize
personas.dsp-ar-repeat-complainer: Several complaints in the past year
personas.cre-mx-past-due: A product with days past due
